description: Verify a citation or DOI, or find research papers on a topic. Searches Crossref (150M+ records) by DOI, keywords, author or title with year and type filters: title, authors with ORCID, journal or publisher, date, type, ISSN/ISBN, citation and reference counts, licence, full-text links and funders. Abstracts are excluded. Use when an agent must check that a reference exists and is cited correctly. $0.005 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

type.description: Crossref type, e.g. journal-article, book-chapter, posted-content

name: paper_lookup
